lead.en: Prove limits with quantified inequalities, distinguish boundedness from convergence, use continuity and series theorems under their hypotheses, and diagnose misleading finite traces.
lead.zh: 用量化不等式证明极限，区分有界与收敛，按假设使用连续性与级数定理，诊断误导有限轨迹。

prerequisites.en: Modules 01 and 04: real functions and domains, finite sums, algebraic inequalities, quantifier order and proof/counterexample structure. No earlier calculus is assumed.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 01 与 04：实函数定义域、有限和、代数不等式、量词顺序及证明反例结构。不假设已学微积分。

en: State sequence convergence with its full quantifier order and prove basic examples.
Distinguish boundedness, monotonicity, divergence and unbounded behaviour.
Compute one-sided/function limits without confusing a punctured domain with a function value.
Give epsilon–delta witnesses and prove continuity/composition claims.
State intermediate/extreme-value hypotheses and use geometric/comparison/ratio tests.
Justify iteration residual/error bounds and explain what finite samples or rounded equality cannot prove.
zh: 写完整数列收敛量词并证明基本例子。
区分有界、单调、发散与无界。
计算单侧、函数极限，区分去心定义域和函数值。
给 ε–δ 见证并证明连续、复合。
写介值、最值假设，使用几何、比较、比值判别。
说明迭代残差误差界与有限样本、舍入相等不能证明什么。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and compare convergence counterexamples.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，比较收敛反例。

text.en: Read limits and real-line continuity selections.
text.zh: 阅读极限与实线连续选段。

text.en: Retrieve quantifiers and distinguish limits from values.
text.zh: 检索量词，区分极限与函数值。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and build explicit inequality proofs.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，构造明确不等式证明。

text.en: Compare finite sequence samples with exact arguments.
text.zh: 比较有限数列样本与精确论证。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore quantified tolerances.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索量化容差。

text.en: Sample both sides and inspect actual floating inputs.
text.zh: 采样两侧并检查实际浮点输入。

text.en: Diagnose the missed feature and update-only stopping rule.
text.zh: 诊断遗漏特征与仅步长停止规则。

text.en: Complete choices and the written quantified claim.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面量化主张。

text.en: Read infinite-process selections and floating-point caveats.
text.zh: 阅读无限过程选段与浮点限制。

text.en: Complete the exit task before derivative definitions.
text.zh: 在导数定义前完成结业任务。
